name: Early Childhood AI Literacy
definition: Ability of young children in the pre-primary years (ages 0-6) to encounter and make sense of basic AI concepts - recognising that AI systems learn from data and make simple predictions - through age-appropriate, playful and creative activities.
uncertainty: Early but growing evidence that pre-primary children can learn basic AI concepts and that their AI literacy can be assessed; samples are small and single-setting (mostly Hong Kong kindergartens), so durability and generalisation need more study.
